description: This file defines the DeviceDao interface for data access operations related to devices in the Thingsboard platform, including methods for querying, saving, and counting device data with various filters.

classes.name: DeviceDao
classes.description: Interface for device data access operations, extending general DAO interfaces for device entities.

methods.name: findDeviceInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves device information by tenant ID and device UUID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a device for a given tenant.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves or updates a device and immediately flushes changes.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds devices associated with a tenant, paginated.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID and device type, paginated.

methods.name: findDeviceIdsByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Finds device IDs by tenant ID and device profile ID, paginated.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndTypeAndEmptyOtaPackage
methods.description: Finds devices with empty OTA packages filtered by tenant, profile, and type.

methods.name: countDevicesByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileIdAndEmptyOtaPackage
methods.description: Counts devices with empty OTA packages filtered by tenant, profile, and type.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds devices by tenant ID and list of device UUIDs.

methods.name: findDevicesByIds
methods.description: Finds devices by a list of UUIDs.

methods.name: findDevicesByIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds devices by a list of UUIDs.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant and customer IDs, paginated.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant, customer, and type, paginated.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdCustomerIdAndIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds devices by tenant, customer, and device IDs.

methods.name: findDeviceByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a device by tenant ID and device name.

methods.name: findTenantDeviceTypesAsync
methods.description: Deprecated method to asynchronously find device types for a tenant.

methods.name: findDeviceByTenantIdAndId
methods.description: Finds a device by tenant ID and device UUID.

methods.name: findDeviceByTenantIdAndIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds a device by tenant ID and UUID.

methods.name: countDevicesByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Counts devices by tenant ID and device profile ID.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndProfileId
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID and profile ID, paginated.

methods.name: findDevicesIdsByDeviceProfileTransportType
methods.description: Finds device IDs filtered by transport type, paginated.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID and edge ID, paginated.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndEdgeIdAndType
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID, edge ID, and type, paginated.

methods.name: findDeviceIdInfos
methods.description: Retrieves paginated device ID info objects.

methods.name: findProfileEntityIdInfos
methods.description: Retrieves paginated profile entity ID info objects.

methods.name: findProfileEntityIdInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves profile entity ID info objects filtered by tenant ID.

methods.name: findDeviceInfosByFilter
methods.description: Finds device info objects based on filter criteria, paginated.
